name: AI CKEditor CEFR
description: Adds a CEFR rewrite plugin for AI CKEditor.
project_description:
AI CKEditor CEFR adds a single AI CKEditor action plugin that rewrites the selected editor text to a chosen CEFR language level (A1-C2). It plugs into the ai_ckeditor dialog flow: the editor selects text, opens the AI Assistant, picks a target CEFR level, clicks Rewrite, and the suggested rewrite is streamed back into a response field that can be saved into CKEditor 5.

The plugin (Drupal\ai_ckeditor_cefr\Plugin\AiCKEditor\CefrLevel) builds a prompt from a configurable template with {{ level }}, {{ level_style_target }} and {{ protected_words_instruction }} placeholders, then hands it to the parent ai_ckeditor request pipeline, which calls the configured drupal/ai chat provider. An optional taxonomy vocabulary supplies protected terms that must be kept unchanged in the rewrite.

Key features:
- CEFR level selector in the AI dialog (A1 Beginner through C2 Proficient).
- Configurable default CEFR level per text-format plugin configuration.
- Editable rewrite prompt template with per-level style targets built in.
- Optional taxonomy vocabulary for protected words/phrases.
- Per-plugin AI provider/model selection (or the AI module chat default).

Requirements: the AI module's ai_ckeditor submodule and core taxonomy. Rewrites run through the configured AI provider and incur provider usage cost.
